Package com.agrialert.alert_manager

Class AlertManagerInitializer

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.alert_manager.AlertManagerInitializer
public final class AlertManagerInitializer extends Object
Coordinates registration of WorkManager jobs that synchronize weather data and generate alerts for the alert manager subsystem.
